# 0.4.15

## 本次更新

- 修复更新 APK 后网页 Cookie 恢复完成前被误判为匿名/过期：现在 Cookie 恢复一旦在后台完成，会重新走服务端会话验证并刷新首页推荐，不再要求用户额外重新登录。

- Fixes cookie loss after an APK update: once the persisted web session finishes restoring, the app re-verifies it with the server and refreshes the home feed instead of leaving a stale anonymous state.
